thigh.definition: The part of the leg between the hip and the knee.

quadricep.definition: One of the large muscles at the front of the thigh that help straighten the knee.
quadricep.exampleUsage: The quadriceps help extend the knee.

hamstring.definition: One of the tendons at the back of the knee.

hip-joint.definition: A rounded end of the thigh bone fits into a hollow in the pelvis, forming a joint that supports body weight as the leg moves.

groin.definition: The crease at the junction of the inner part of the thigh with the trunk together with the adjacent region and often including the external genitals.

inner-thigh.definition: The side of the upper leg that faces toward the other leg.
inner-thigh.exampleUsage: The diagram labels the inner thigh.

outer-thigh.definition: The side of the upper leg that faces away from the other leg.
outer-thigh.exampleUsage: The illustration labels the outer thigh.

femur.definition: The longest and thickest bone of the human skeleton.

hip-flexor.definition: One of the muscles that help bend the hip and lift the thigh toward the body.
hip-flexor.exampleUsage: The hip flexors help lift the leg forward.

iliac-crest.definition: The curved upper border of the ilium, the broad upper part of the pelvic bone.
iliac-crest.exampleUsage: The anatomy diagram labels the iliac crest.

knee.definition: Hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella.

kneecap.definition: A small flat triangular bone in front of the knee that protects the knee joint.

shin.definition: The inner and thicker of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

calf.definition: Fine leather from the skin of a calf.

tibia.definition: The inner and thicker of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

fibula.definition: The outer and thinner of the two bones of the human leg between the knee and ankle.

achilles-tendon.definition: The strong tendon at the back of the ankle that connects the calf muscles to the heel bone.
achilles-tendon.exampleUsage: The Achilles tendon connects the calf to the heel.

popliteal.definition: Of or relating to the area behind the knee joint.

meniscus.definition: (anatomy) a disk of cartilage that serves as a cushion between the ends of bones that meet at a joint.

ligament.definition: A sheet or band of tough fibrous tissue connecting bones or cartilages or supporting muscles or organs.

foot.definition: The part of the leg of a human being below the ankle joint.

ankle.definition: A gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus.

heel.definition: To strike with the heel of the club.

arch.definition: A curved bony structure supporting or enclosing organs (especially the inner sides of the feet).

ball-of-foot.definition: The padded area on the sole of the foot just behind the toes.
ball-of-foot.exampleUsage: The ball of the foot bears weight during walking.

ankle-bone.definition: A common term for the bony prominence on either side of the ankle, formed by the ends of the lower-leg bones.
ankle-bone.exampleUsage: The diagram marks the ankle bone on both sides.

plantar.definition: Relating to or occurring on the undersurface of the foot.

metatarsal.definition: Any bone of the foot between the ankle and the toes.

big-toe.definition: The innermost and usually largest digit of the foot is called the big toe.

little-toe.definition: The smallest toe, positioned at the outer edge of the foot.

toenail.definition: The nail at the end of a toe.

toe-pad.definition: The soft padded area on the underside of a toe.
toe-pad.exampleUsage: The toe pad cushions contact with the ground.

toe-joint.definition: A joint where bones of a toe meet and allow movement.
toe-joint.exampleUsage: The toe joint bends during walking.

bunion.definition: A painful swelling of the bursa of the first joint of the big toe.

callus.definition: An area of skin that is thick or hard from continual pressure or friction (as the sole of the foot).

blister.definition: A flaw on a surface resulting when an applied substance does not adhere (as an air bubble in a coat of paint).

cuticle.definition: The dead skin at the base of a fingernail or toenail.

nail-bed.definition: The skin and tissue beneath a fingernail or toenail that supports the nail plate.
nail-bed.exampleUsage: The nail bed lies beneath the hard nail plate.

walk.definition: To move on foot at a regular pace.

lunge.definition: (fencing) an attacking thrust made with one foot forward and the back leg straight and with the sword arm outstretched forward.

kick.definition: The act of delivering a blow with the foot.

kneel.definition: To rest one's weight on one's knees.

crouch.definition: The act of bending low with the limbs close to the body.

stride.definition: Significant progress (especially in the phrase ‘make strides’).
